notes.title: Patch Update 1.19
notes.notes:
Hey! 😎
Long time no see. Life has kept me busy the past few months. Here's finally a long overdue patch, which improves the overall player experience, especially when controlling and navigating the game.
Just in time for the Zombies vs Vampires Fest! Enjoy!

Fixes and additions:

 Fixed information inconsistencies in character dialogues.
 Improved panning navigation in map view.
 Adjusted handgun aiming for improved accuracy.
 Updated game controller instructions for shoulder buttons.
 Added a note with instructions for circuit wires puzzle in the Utility room.
 Block world interaction when selecting "Continue" from pause menu.
 Block grenade and reload actions when interacting with menus.
 Remapped grenade button on game controllers to Left Shoulder Button.
 Updated UI buttons highlight graphic to be more prominent.
 Some bugfixes and optimizations related to Mods.
 Some bugfixes related to Objectives.

That's it for now. Until next time!

notes.title: Content Update 1.15
notes.notes:
Hey! 😎
It's time for a proper quality of life content update. This one's coming to you with the new unlockable game mode "Waves".

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211860/a50b89af0e81e5fca2646b0d4417879731ce2aaa.gif

The new Waves mode features 3 games: Score attack, Survival and Custom. The first two game types are connected to a global leaderboard; get the highest kill score or survive for the longest time! In "Custom" games you can play around with your own time and waves limit without competition. Unlock this mode by completing the game and get the Waves mode achievement.

There's also some graphical updates, which improves the post-processing effects and the resolution scaling. 

And last but not least: a new weapon - straight from Lang's private collection! This one's got some huge kickback.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211860/3a66f17ee82b740e68ca3e4d0177036c7cb2c845.gif

Fixes and additions:

Added unlockable game mode "Waves" with leaderboards.
Added Dithering filter option to settings panel with default setting OFF.
Added new weapon: "Wessersmith" revolver (from Lang's "private collection").
Adjusted resolution scaling.
Updated post-processing effects.
Updated objectives descriptions.
Updated dialogue UI to better distinguish between keyboard and controller inputs.
Some minor bug fixes and adjustments.

That's it for now!
[previewyoutube=gj5HzO0GmtE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Status update #2
notes.notes:
Hey!
Some good news this time.

As mentioned in the previous status update, there was some game engine bugs that messed up the main scene file. I've since managed to restore the project to it's original state by bringing out some backups. 

This puts me back on track for making some updates to the game. Additional steps are taken to avoid these issues/bugs in the future and all the stress and headaches that comes with it.

Thank you for your patience and understanding and stay tuned for upcoming game updates!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211860/a2154f0de93925d1c5b280b7a10246a51d6aa4bd.gif

notes.title: Status update
notes.notes:
Hello!
Let me start with the good news: The latest version of the game is uploaded and ready to be released on Steam. 

The bad news: I've run into a pretty serious game engine bug (yes, Unity), which has messed up the main scene file. Luckily I had already built and uploaded the latest version before this happened, so the release can go ahead as scheduled. Unfortunately, this hiccup will probably cause significant delays to possible future updates.

I wanted to be as upfront about this as possible so you know what's going on and to set future expectations accordingly regarding game updates.

For now, I will take a step back to take a breather and review the situation. Hopefully this should be fixed as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience and understanding!

Until next time!

notes.title: Demo release
notes.notes:
Hello!
I just realized this is the first announcement made on this Steam page.
I've been keeping busy preparing a demo of Zero Below The Sun, which will be made available for Steam Next Fest on Feb 5.

The demo has approximately 30 minutes of gameplay or longer depending on your play style. Of course, you can take as long as you like in order to get a feel for the game.

I hope you will like it, whether you are a fan of classic survival horror games or horror games in general.

Until then!
